# account service

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:accountService`](gmeow-accountService.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/accountService>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/accounts`](../../slices/accounts.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The online service an account is held with. Functional — an account is on one service.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:OnlineAccount`](../classes/gmeow-OnlineAccount.md) -> [`gmeow:OnlineService`](../classes/gmeow-OnlineService.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:accountService`](gmeow-accountService.md) from [`gmeow:OnlineAccount`](../classes/gmeow-OnlineAccount.md) to [`gmeow:OnlineService`](../classes/gmeow-OnlineService.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:OnlineAccount`](../classes/gmeow-OnlineAccount.md), [`gmeow:OnlineService`](../classes/gmeow-OnlineService.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to link an account to the single service or platform it is held with — the account-to-service edge that places a handle on its network, forge, or federated instance.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the holder of the account (use [`gmeow:holdsAccount`](gmeow-holdsAccount.md)) and for the service's homepage IRI (use [`gmeow:accountServiceHomepage`](gmeow-accountServiceHomepage.md)); since it is functional, never assert two services for one account — model a moved account as a distinct [`OnlineAccount`](../classes/gmeow-OnlineAccount.md).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:accountService`](gmeow-accountService.md) from the [`OnlineAccount`](../classes/gmeow-OnlineAccount.md) to its [`gmeow:OnlineService`](../classes/gmeow-OnlineService.md); read the service's liveness from that service object rather than duplicating status on every account.
